changes.title: Better Continue Watching
changes.description: Continue Watching is more reliable across supported streaming services and updates when you switch profiles.

changes.title: Faster Site Switching
changes.description: Switch between your streaming sites more quickly and return to where you left off.

changes.title: Disney+ Continue Watching Fixes
changes.description: Movies and shows from Disney+ now appear more reliably in Continue Watching.

changes.title: Reorder Your Sites
changes.description: Drag sites in the sidebar to change their order. Your order is saved for the next time you open Wianu.

changes.title: Automatic Continue Watching
changes.description: Start watching on Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, Prime Video, or Apple TV in Wianu. Your videos appear automatically in Continue Watching in the sidebar, so you can return to them later.

changes.title: What's New
changes.description: See the latest changes after updating Wianu. Reopen these notes anytime from the Help menu.

changes.title: Support Wianu
changes.description: Enjoying Wianu? A new optional reminder lets you support its development. You can dismiss it or turn off future reminders.
